methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Albacore is a Seed-stage company in the Ocean & Maritime sector founded by John Huddleston and Dante Vaisbort. The company has raised $6.5M to date. The comparable universe consists of three private peers—Standard Subsea, Clippership, and NetworkOcean—with no public comps available in the sector.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. Using total capital raised ($6.5M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $16M. This single-method framework supports a range bounded by $14M at the low end (incorporating downside variance) and $19M at the high end.

The analysis supports a median valuation of $16M for Albacore. Key uncertainties stem from the limited comparables dataset and the reliance on a single valuation method; a more robust triangulation would require revenue multiples or DCF analysis, neither of which is available here. The narrow private peer universe and absence of public market reference points constrain conviction in this range. Management should be prepared to anchor discussions in the $14M–$19M band pending access to deeper comparables or financial performance data.
